mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO request_idempotency (tenant_id, key_hash, fingerprint, state, owner_token, fencing_token, lease_expires_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{keyHash}, #{fingerprint}, 'PROCESSING', #{ownerToken}, 1, #{leaseExpiresAt}, #{expiresAt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3), UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, key_hash, fingerprint, state, owner_token, fencing_token, lease_expires_at, response_status, response_content_type, response_payload, completed_at, expires_at FROM request_idempotency WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND key_hash = #{keyHash} FOR UPDATE
